name: University of Waikato
feeMethod: Publishes a fee per qualification, sometimes as a range across majors, so the calculator takes the top of the range.
description: The University of Waikato is a public university founded in 1964 in Hamilton, with a second campus in Tauranga. It teaches arts, business, computing, education, engineering, health, law, science and social sciences.
whyIncluded: Waikato accepts the Singapore-Cambridge GCE A-Level with at least three H2 passes at C grade for undergraduate entry.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for a student in a catered hall in Hamilton: room with meals, bus fares, phone, entertainment, textbooks and clothes. Excludes insurance, visa and flights.
livingCosts.notes: Waikato 'Cost of living' page (no year stated; 2026 = year read), Hamilton halls of residence column, weekly x 52/12. Housing: fully catered hall $446-$510/wk, midpoint $478 (meals included, so food is 0). Transport: public transport $15+/wk. Personal: mobile phone $10+ + entertainment $50+ per week ($260/month) plus annual textbooks and printing $500+ and clothes and toiletries $500+ ($83.33/month). Page's Hamilton weekly total $351-$635; self-catered halls $276-$332/wk. Excludes bond $450-$680, insurance from $855/yr, visa $700-$850 and flights. Minimum ('+') figures used where the page gives only a floor.

programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students for 2027, including GST; the actual fee depends on papers chosen. Student services fee included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2027 international fee per year from Waikato's international tuition costs table (BE(Hons), 480 points = 4 years). Compulsory = 2026 Student Services Fee $9.25/point x 120 = $1,110 (https://www.waikato.ac.nz/study/fees-costs/student-services; 2027 rate not yet published). Excludes insurance. Fees incl. Round 4 (2026-10-13): Waikato's international fees page now shows only 2026 and 2027, and agent pages found (therightu.com, collegedunia) give undated figures. Round 5 (2026-10-13): still no 2024/2025 row. Checked with direct fetches: the international fees page (and its ?archiveDate= variants) shows only 2026/2027; the site sitemap (about 11,800 URLs) has no older fee page; the International Student Guide 2026-2027 PDF has no tuition table and the 2024 guide PDF is no longer hosted (404); the qualification pages give an undated 'Estimated fees' figure only; no Waikato issuu account was found. Round 6 (2026-10-13): still no 2024/2025 row. The 2025 International Student Guide PDF (assets/Uploads/Study-with-us/Prospectus/2025-International-Student-Guide-University-of-Waikato.pdf) and its research.waikato.ac.nz copy are gone (404/530), the uol.de 2025 fact sheet is 404 and the Gostralia-hosted international prospectus fails TLS and 404s over HTTP; the old /international/fees-and-costs URL now redirects to the 2026/2027 page. A search snippet of that old page showed 2025 per-major ranges (e.g. BA $30,897-$40,220), a different basis from the single programme figure used here, and no copy of it could be fetched. The qualification page's undated 'Estimated fees' (BCS $42,635) matches neither the 2026 nor the 2027 table. Round 7 (2026-10-13, Common Crawl captures of official pages): Waikato 2024 international tuition table (page "refer to study in 2024", Common Crawl capture 2024-07-23; same table at /study/costs/tuition-costs-international captured 2023-11-30). Compulsory = 2025 Student Services Fee $9.00/point x 120 = $1,080 (waikato.ac.nz/study/fees-costs/student-services, CC 20250328115539 and /int/ 20250217034751: 'In 2025, students will be charged a levy of $9.00 per credit point', full-time 120 credits $1,080).
